items.item_text: California Pharmacist License eligible and possess a valid license at the time of hire
Immunization Certification
American Heart Association (AHA) or American Red Cross Basic Life Support (BLS), or UC Davis Health CPR
Doctor of Pharmacy Degree from an accredited college or university, or equivalent training
Recent Outpatient Retail Pharmacy experience working as a Registered Pharmacist (last 2 years)
Experience working in a Hospital Outpatient Pharmacy
Experience performing QA and order verification
Experience working with and directing residents, students, and health care professionals.
Patient counseling experience
Experience with LAI injections
Customer service experience
Two (2) years Outpatient Experience

The purpose of the position is to provide comprehensive dispensing and clinical pharmaceutical services to ambulatory patients and to other professional staff as well as overseeing pharmacy technicians and other subordinates in performing technical and clerical functions. Working in one of five outpatient pharmacies, the pharmacist ensures safe, accurate, and timely medication delivery while offering expert consultation to patients and healthcare providers. This role also includes supervising pharmacy technicians and support staff in the performance of technical and clerical functions. As part of a large, integrated pharmacy team operating 24/7, the pharmacist plays a critical role in promoting optimal medication use, delivering high-quality patient care, and supporting the department’s commitment to excellence in service, education, and innovation.
70% - Participates in Drug Distribution
20% - Participates in Clinical Activities
10% - Participates in Administrative Activities
Working knowledge of Medi-Cal Formulary and other third- party billing systems
Knowledge of Pharmacy Clinical Services
Ability to accurately perform pharmacy calculations
Ability to oversee technicians and establish priorities of workflow
Ability to interpret and understand physicians' orders, pharmacy, and nursing records
Computer skills that facilitate medication order entry and other basic clinical software programs
Current knowledge of pharmacy terminology, generic/brand names, abbreviations and drugs on current hospital formulary

Problem-solving skills to independently recognize and define a problem, identify the resources available to help solve the problem, create and implement viable solutions, and follow through to ensure the problem is resolved to the satisfaction of all parties
Ability to read, write and speak English
Ability to independently exercise delegated authority to take action, and to recognize when it is appropriate to seek assistance from others, when limits of delegated authority have been reached
